observations: Four required original sources and the existing durable replay implementation were fetched in full and independently checked by UTF8 byte length, SHA256 and canonical Git blob identity.

The original replay parser already verifies checksums, bounded canonical event decoding, prepare/apply and canonical-frame equality. This module uses that existing machinery over borrowed input without file recovery or tail repair.

Encoder additionally compares the complete original LedgerRecord with the replayed record, retaining explicit event_digest integrity even though it is derived rather than separately transmitted by the original frame format.
All ten current event variants are handled by an exhaustive pre-clone bounds match; scalar StableId representation and original decoder retain their original128-byte bound.

The existing pure ledger causal checks reject missing episodes, unsupported outcomes, duplicate identities, role self-labeling within content, and other original invariants. These checks do not authenticate the values or replace original signed trust/freeze validation.
No original ledger/model/durable/durable_codec body or Cargo file changes. The sole existing-file edit is private module registration plus four explicit public exports in lib.rs.
New production module199 lines and tests384 lines; fixed output capacity65536, borrowed frame slicing, no allocation derived from the untrusted record count.
expected_test_strength: The full fixture contains all10 LedgerEvent variants with normalization, causal predecessors, authenticated-role content, credit conservation, revocation and unlearning lineage; equality compares every event/record/head and original from_snapshot replay.
Malformed tests recompute valid original frame checksums so rejection cannot rely only on a checksum mismatch.

Every truncated prefix of a one-record snapshot, arbitrary tail, excessive count/length, missing record, aggregate overflow, duplicate/reordering, noncanonical candidate order and original causal failure are represented.

The aggregate boundary test grows an actual valid original ledger through the first overflowing complete frame and requires the last complete fitting snapshot to roundtrip; no truncation fallback exists.
limitations: No Rust parser, compiler, formatter, Clippy, tests, native process, source gate or qualification was executed for this candidate.
Test source is authored coverage, not an observed pass; exact full fixture validity/typechecking remain subject to the original future pipeline.
Pure content validation intentionally permits arbitrary well-formed content that lacks authentic signatures; caller trust and signed freeze verification are mandatory.
The codec limit does not include external base64/JSON/control metadata. Existing parent complete-message64KiB enforcement must remain separate.
The three files are an independent proposal against the exact original lib, not a ref/source update or completed merge into the larger provider candidate.
